text:
Ravi P.: Quick PSA: hit an SDK vs REST parity gap while wiring up the sample-app embeddings pipeline. The REST API accepts a bulk array but the Python SDK (v0.9.1) only supports single-input and silently munges arrays into a comma-joined string.

Ravi P.: REST repro (works):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embedding-1","inputs":["x","y","z"]}' | jq
```

Ravi P.: Python SDK attempt (fails / wrong shape):
```py
# redwood-sdk v0.9.1
from redwood import Redwood
r = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
# intended: three inputs
r.embeddings.create(model='open-embedding-1', input=['x','y','z'])
# server error: 400 invalid_request: invalid input type
```

Ravi P.: Local capture shows SDK POST /v1/embeddings with body `{"input":"['x', 'y', 'z']"}`. So two problems: uses `input` not `inputs` and it stringifies the array. Also observed retry difference: when the hosted API responded 429 + Retry-After, our direct REST caller respected Retry-After but SDK retried twice immediately (no visible hook to opt-out), which caused duplicate work and inflated cost.

Marta K.: ugh. This likely regressed when we added the server-side /embeddings/bulk route and didn't update language clients. Which repo is the python client in? Has there been a change in the request serializer?

Eli W.: I can look. If the client only implements `embeddings.create` for single input, we should add `embeddings.bulk(inputs=...)` to mirror REST. Also we need to update the low-level request builder to avoid auto-stringifying non-string bodies.

Sam H.: For the retry behavior, the SDK's default retry middleware uses exponential backoff but currently ignores Retry-After header. We should honor Retry-After and expose a `retry_hook` callback so apps can observe/reject retries.

CI Bot: Integration tests: python-sdk e2e started 1799000200; test 'embeddings_bulk_accepts_array' failed (400)

Ravi P.: Short-term workaround: call the bulk REST endpoint from the sample-app's loader. Example fetch in Node or requests in Python. I'll patch the sample-app docs and mark onboarding issue.

Eli W.: Plan of record: (1) add embeddings.bulk to python SDK and update JS SDK parity check; (2) fix serializer to send `inputs` array when passed; (3) update retry middleware to honor Retry-After and add opt-out hook; (4) add sdk-integration e2e that posts 3-item batch and asserts no coercion; (5) docs patch to mention bulk usage.

Marta K.: I'll open a GH issue and add label `sdk/parity` + `regression`. Ravi, can you paste the full failing request/response in the issue?

Ravi P.: Done, linked this thread. Marked as blocker for sample-app onboarding flow because many customers upload batched data. Also added the REST workaround snippet to the quickstart.

Sam H.: I'll prepare a small PR for the retry header change and a breaking-note in the changelog (behavior change: Retry-After honored). Non-breaking: we add bulk method.

Eli W.: After PR we should run the new e2e against staging and prod-like host to confirm no perf regressions.

Ravi P.: Thanks folks :thumbsup: — keeping sample-app on REST call until SDK release.
